title: Claude Agent SDK workshops
description: Guided JupyterLab workshops for the Claude Agent SDK for Python: what an agent is and how to run one, how to extend it, and how to build a chat application on it.

collections.title: Agent foundations with the Claude Agent SDK
collections.description: Guided JupyterLab workshops on what an AI agent is and how to run one with the Claude Agent SDK for Python: the agent loop, tools and their results, what a run costs, instructions, models, permissions, conversations, sessions, streaming and structured output.

collections.title: Extending an agent with the Claude Agent SDK
collections.description: Guided JupyterLab workshops on giving an agent built with the Claude Agent SDK for Python more to work with: your own tools, MCP servers, your own data, project instructions, skills, approvals, hooks, subagents and long sessions.

collections.title: Building a chat app with the Claude Agent SDK
collections.description: Guided JupyterLab workshops that build a web chat application on the Claude Agent SDK for Python, a step at a time: a first reply, streaming, a conversation per visitor, showing the agent's work, approvals, tools, history and usage.
